note: Pre-launch security audit fixes (2026-07-13): admin_users UPDATE fully revoked from authenticated (was: any admin could self-promote to SUPER_ADMIN via business_id-only RLS check with no role restriction); combo_bookings anon/public INSERT policies dropped (was: anon could insert payment_status=PAID directly, bypassing Paysafe); combo_booking_items_anon_insert dropped (settlement forgery); promotion_uses_anon_insert dropped (promo abuse); holds_authenticated_all split into select/update/delete (tenant-scoped, matching prior qual) with INSERT now default-deny (was: with_check=true let any authenticated session write holds against any tenant); zero-policy tables (processed_wa_messages, wa_messages, business_partnerships, combo_settlements, invite_tokens, ngt_intake_submissions, ngt_payments, tenant_invoice_sequences) had broad anon/authenticated grants revoked (RLS already default-denied these, but grants were unnecessarily broad). Migrations: 20260713144334_security_audit_fixes, 20260713144422_security_audit_fixes_c1_correction, plus an admin_setup_token_used_hash column addition. | 2026-08-15 (20260815120000_close_anon_cross_tenant_booking_reads): bookings_read POST/PATCH read-back clause scoped to the writing tenant + DRAFT/PENDING (was: ANY POST or PATCH — including every /rpc/* call — disabled the policy entirely, exposing all tenants' bookings to anon; proven live via check_loyalty); search_bookings_by_ref dropped (SECURITY DEFINER + PUBLIC EXECUTE + caller-supplied business_id, no caller in repo); calculate_booking_refund and check_loyalty EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC and anon. | 2026-08-15 (20260815140000_onboarding_wizard): new anonymous write path for client onboarding. Edge fn onboarding-wizard is verify_jwt=false and reachable by anyone; its gate is a single-use, unexpired invite_tokens row that resolves to exactly one business_id, plus per-IP check_rate_limit. No request may supply a business_id and writable columns are whitelisted per step, so the encrypted credential columns, subdomain and subscription_status are unreachable from the wizard. Skeleton tenants are created with subscription_status='ONBOARDING' (outside the TRADING set) so a half-finished onboarding cannot take money. New storage bucket onboarding-assets grants anon INSERT, bounded by a 5MB cap and an image-only mime allowlist; the bucket is public-read by design. No public-schema grants, policies or RLS state changed, which is why this snapshot's arrays are unchanged.
